title: Chesapeake Beach Guided Walking Tour Railway Trail
includes: Radios for clear communications of the guide's presentation
Water at the start of the tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
You must call 24 hours before your tour time to see if the minimum requirement of 4 walkers has been met.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Chesapeake Windsail Tours, a division of Chesapeake Windsail Cruises, is offering a wonderful way to enjoy Chesapeake Beach, with a stroll back into time down the old railway trail that once brought visitors from Washington DC, Baltimore and other destinations to the beaches. You will enjoy the peace and quiet of the marshland off Fishing Creek, where you will have many opportunities to photograph the habitat of the Chesapeake Bay region. You will visit the site where the war heroes of Chesapeake Beach are honored. This tour will end with a visit inside the Chesapeake Railway Museum. Learn about life in the early 20th century, before the Chesapeake Bay Bridge and why people came down to visit and to stay here. These are just a few of the sights on this tour. We are not responsible for the operation hours of the museum. You must call 24 hours before your tour time to see if the minimum requirement of 4 walkers has been met.
